newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Clinton opens back channel to junior Netanyahu.
newsitem.headline: Clinton opens back channel to junior Netanyahu.

text.p: Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu disclosed on Saturday that U.S. President Bill Clinton had opened secret back channel talks with the Jewish state -- he had a meeting with five-year-old Yair Netanyahu.
"He (Clinton) said to me: 'I heard your son Yair was here. Maybe you'll bring him to my office'," Netanyahu told Israel army radio while on an official visit to the United States.
"He certainly wanted a very comprehensive and substantive political discussion," Netanyahu revealed.
"I consulted with him (Yair). He told me he was in fact interested in meeting the Prime Minister of the United States," Netanyahu chuckled.
The Israeli leader, who met with Clinton on Thursday, said Yair was accompanied by mother Sara and baby brother Avner on the 20-minute meeting on Friday.
"I have not yet received a comprehensive briefing on these discussions. It appears the cat was also involved in them," Netanyahu said, referring to the Clintons' cat Socks.
In a move to neutralise domestic critics who disapprove of the public prominence given to the young Netanyahus, the prime minister said:
"I estimate that the State of Israel will not have to pay for my childrens' visit to the office of the President of the United States."
